page.layout: One block: a single column of running text. At the head, a running title in italics above the text. At the foot, a small faint line of signature-like marks and a catchword-like mark "col." at the right, which is not clearly legible. No margin notes.

main_text.p: uxorem functus es. Quid vero in ea, siue à Senatu cum decernitur, siue à te dum suscipitur, vel à nobis cum laudatur, non mirum, non prodigiosum, non superbum occurrit? Videtur ob oculos adhuc versari apparatus, quem Brixiae dabas in conspectum. En tibi currus innumeri senis equis trahuntur. Qui autem currus? rotae, axes, columnae aureis nitent sculpturis; laminae, clauique solido rigent argento; cortinae, ac sellae pretiosa textura rigescunt. Quid etiam equi? nam aurea mandunt fræna, gerunt ephippia vnionibus texta, falleras acupictas demittunt, surriguntur

page.notes: The running title is read as "Austriae, Imperatoris Leopoldi", set in italic with the heading words. The final line is partly illegible at the foot, and the bottom marks are doubtful. The word "Brixiae" and some words in the last lines are doubtful; the last line's "surriguntur" is copied as best read. The note at the foot is faint and not clearly readable.
